nalli:10296727175467.description: Chhaya, our Bengal cotton saree, draws inspiration from the clean, modern lines of Piet Mondrian. A contrasting band forms the top border, creating a striking visual highlight across the body, while minimal stripes along the base and pallu introduce structure and balance. Bold colour blocks reinterpret Chhaya, meaning shadow in Hindi, and the solid pallu completes the look with contemporary ease.

nalli:10068536426795.description: Inspired by daffodils and pressed flowers, this saree captures nostalgic beauty with clean white lines tracing delicate floral curves. Golden zari accents enhance contrast, while bold blooms on the pallu add drama. Crafted in pure silk organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. it features a gold beaded trim and zari embroidery in the pallu.

nalli:10053251825963.description: Step into a world of tussars with Pomegranate Poetry by Nalli, celebrating joy and abundance. This Tussar silk saree features a plain first half, while the other half showcases pomegranate butis. A zari border and lined pallu enhance its soft, lustrous drape with timeless grace.

nalli:10296727208235.description: Chhaya, our Bengal cotton saree, draws inspiration from the clean, modern lines of Piet Mondrian. A contrasting band forms the top border, creating a striking visual highlight across the body, while minimal stripes along the base and pallu introduce structure and balance. Bold colour blocks reinterpret Chhaya, meaning shadow in Hindi, and the solid pallu completes the look with contemporary ease.

nalli:10296725537067.description: Patang features fine multi-coloured checks woven using four harmonious hues, creating a lively yet balanced design. Translating to Kite in Hindi, the saree reflects the light, easy spirit of a patang gliding across an open sky. The border and pallu are minimal, finished with delicate zari accents that add subtle richness. With its balanced play of colour, it makes for a breathable, comfortable drape.

nalli:10296725307691.description: Mishri, a celebration of summer in Bengal cotton, is woven in fine 60-count cotton and drapes with natural comfort. Light, breathable, and effortlessly wearable for sunlit days.

nalli:10296726487339.description: Patang features fine multi-coloured checks woven using four harmonious hues, creating a lively yet balanced design. Translating to Kite in Hindi, the saree reflects the light, easy spirit of a patang gliding across an open sky. The border and pallu are minimal, finished with delicate zari accents that add subtle richness. With its balanced play of colour, it makes for a breathable, comfortable drape.

nalli:10296724816171.description: Titli, framed with proportioned stripes that gradually narrow towards the body, bringing together a vibrant palette in harmony. Where the border and pallu stripes meet, tiny checks appear, evoking abstract butterflies - delicate creatures of spring and summer. The plain body offers soft contrast, allowing the colours to shine. On the pallu, these stripes return as subtle checks, adding a light, balanced finish.

nalli:10296724881707.description: Surahi, a name that evokes the earth and grounded beauty, carries a sense of calm poise in its design. Woven in fine cotton, it is framed by a striking zari border where gold and silver stripes meet a slender accent line, adding subtle distinction. Rich colour tones and a refined striped layout lend it quiet elegance, while a broad gold zari band completes the border with a distinct finish.

nalli:10296724652331.description: Titli, framed with proportioned stripes that gradually narrow towards the body, bringing together a vibrant palette in harmony. Where the border and pallu stripes meet, tiny checks appear, evoking abstract butterflies - delicate creatures of spring and summer. The plain body offers soft contrast, allowing the colours to shine. On the pallu, these stripes return as subtle checks, adding a light, balanced finish.

nalli:10053224464683.description: The Chili Lily Tussar Silk Saree from Nalli’s Yours Truly Collection blends spice and sweetness with chili and floral motifs. Featuring zari-striped borders, a floral-accented pallu, and soft spun tussar silk, it drapes elegantly—celebrating individuality, joy, and freedom in every fold.

nalli:10068550189355.description: Crafted in cotton tissue, this saree draws inspiration from ikebana, the Japanese art of floral arrangement, reflecting balance and harmony. The design allows florals to breathe in an elegant composition, while a woven zari border enhances its beauty, capturing ikebana’s simplicity and deep reverence for nature.

nalli:10296726323499.description: Patang features fine multi-coloured checks woven using four harmonious hues, creating a lively yet balanced design. Translating to Kite in Hindi, the saree reflects the light, easy spirit of a patang gliding across an open sky. The border and pallu are minimal, finished with delicate zari accents that add subtle richness. With its balanced play of colour, it makes for a breathable, comfortable drape.

nalli:10296725242155.description: Kuhu, named after the soft call of the koel that signals the arrival of summer, carries the same cheerful warmth in its colours. The palette brings together softer tones and brighter hues in a lively blend. Rendered in cotton, it features asymmetrical borders and subtle zari stripes across the body, while the pallu continues the stripe play, edged in delicate zari for a bright, balanced finish.

nalli:10296725405995.description: Mishri, a celebration of summer in Bengal cotton, is woven in fine 60-count cotton and drapes with natural comfort. Soft stripes move in gentle linear patterns across the fabric, creating a lively yet balanced design. The fine checks they form are a gentle reminder of crystal sugar, lending the saree its name. Light, breathable, and effortlessly wearable for sunlit days.

nalli:10296725111083.description: Mogra is designed to feel light and effortless. Its muted pastels draw from the soft, fragrant bloom of jasmine, mogra, giving the saree its name. Intentional colour-blocking lends it a distinct presence, while contrasting panels shape the pleats and pallu with quiet structure. Fine vertical stripes add subtle detail, and silver zari stripes on the pallu offer a gentle, radiant highlight.

nalli:10053257199915.description: Unleash the wilderness with our "Prowl and Prance" Tussar Silk Saree from Nalli's Yours Truly Collection. Crafted from spun Tussar silk, it features shimmering zari lines, a plain zari border, and a striking pallu with a prowling leopard. Soft, lustrous, and gracefully draped, it exudes bold elegance.

nalli:10053227512107.description: Dive into whimsy with the Pisces in Paris Tussar Saree, celebrating koi fish symbolism and vibrant life. Featuring fish motifs between pleats, clustered borders, and a patterned pallu, its lustrous fabric drapes effortlessly—a statement of joy, luck, and cultural richness in every fold.

nalli:10053277876523.description: Experience love blooming in every fold of our Perfume of Love Tussar silk saree. Featuring jasmine flower and petal motifs in an alternating pattern, it evokes moonlit elegance. A striped border and pallu add rhythmic charm, while its lustrous drape ensures the celebration of life's simplest joys.

nalli:10296727142699.description: Chhaya, our Bengal cotton saree, draws inspiration from the clean, modern lines of Piet Mondrian. A contrasting band forms the top border, creating a striking visual highlight across the body, while minimal stripes along the base and pallu introduce structure and balance. Bold colour blocks reinterpret Chhaya, meaning shadow in Hindi, and the solid pallu completes the look with contemporary ease.

nalli:10053256085803.description: Embrace playful charm with "Banana Bandit" by Nalli, a Tussar silk saree inspired by carefree monkeys under the sun. The body transitions from serene simplicity to lively monkey motifs, symbolizing joy. A plain zari border and zari-lined pallu complete its soft, lustrous drape.

nalli:10064276783403.description: The Vasanthika Pure Kanchipuram Silk Saree from Nalli’s Shubhra collection celebrates spring and transformation with Mayil Kondrai (Gulmohar) jhaal and Kili (Parrot) motifs. nalli:10052025385259.description: The Sadhvi Kanchipuram saree features vertical lines of rudraksha motifs with a flow of tiny dots throughout. The simple border has rudraksha bands, while the pallu displays rudraksha lines, a weft-faced diamond pattern, and thalampu-reku motifs, reflecting tradition and elegance.

nalli:10060718211371.description: Ramya is a radiant Bridal Handloom saree woven with Gold Zari, featuring Manga motifs inspired by the Mangamali necklace. nalli:10061177913643.description: Our 'Mayil' Kanchipuram silk saree, woven over 275 hours, features a korvai border and petni pallu. nalli:10061120962859.description: The Maangai Pure Kanchipuram Silk Saree from Nalli’s Shubhra collection features Maanga foliage motifs, symbolizing prosperity. Its border showcases Neetru Varisai and Vattam Suzhi, while the pallu highlights Samanthi poo and zari twill lines.

nalli:10059361845547.description: Ramya, a deep red Bridal Kanchipuram Handloom saree, features the Manga (paisley) motif, symbolizing prosperity. The pallu’s floral designs and golden zari stripe add elegance, while the Getty border enhances its royal appeal, celebrating Kanchipuram artistry.

nalli:10059353129259.description: Malhar, an Araku Bridal Kanchipuram Handloom Saree in Gold Zari, is inspired by Thewa craft. The pallu, adorned with peacocks, parrots, and hamsas, reflects harmony, making this saree a timeless tribute to tradition.

nalli:10176046072107.description: The 'Mayilkan' Kanjeevaram silk saree from our Alankar collection celebrates the peacock, a symbol of grace and beauty. The body features intricate mayil motifs, while the lower half and border weave peacocks amid delicate florals. A subtle twill border frames the saree, and the pallu echoes the same detailing, completing it with quiet elegance.

nalli:10176046170411.description: The 'Lasya' Kanjeevaram silk saree from our Indira collection embodies a graceful balance of form and detail. Its body features alternating floral butas, a bold tree-like motif and a delicate single bloom. The border carries a flowing floral vine framed by ghetti band and muthu seeru. A rich ghetti pallu brings these elements together with elegance and continuity.

nalli:10176046203179.description: The 'Valaiyalam' Kanjeevaram silk saree from our Indira collection reflects understated grandeur rooted in tradition. Its body features an intricate floral brocade, while the rich border brings a contemporary edge with harmonised design elements. Lattice-detailed outer stripes add gentle contrast, and the pallu completes the look with woven peacocks and motifs from the border.

nalli:10176046268715.description: Our 'Aaditi' Kanjeevaram saree from the Alankar collection is handwoven in four-ply pure silk, giving it a graceful, fluid drape. The body is richly detailed with brocade work featuring graceful deer woven among delicate floral vines, with thazhampoo creepers rising from the rich zari ghetti border, and a pair of deer placed within the pallu's ghetti panels for a balanced finish.

nalli:10176046465323.description: Our 'Nayantara' Kanjeevaram silk saree, from our Sangam collection, is handwoven over 165 hours in 4-ply pure mulberry silk. The design is a tribute to the beauty of floral vines, with the body featuring delicate creeper motifs that lend a soft, fluid texture. Its contrast petni pallu is adorned with flowing floral strings and framed by rich ghetti bands.
tags: Koadu Kattam and Half & Half - Half Fine/Without Zari

nalli:10176046498091.description: Ballari, from our Sangam collection, is an expression of classic Kanjeevaram craftsmanship, handwoven over 165 hours in 4-ply pure silk. It features a contemporary borderless design, with the body adorned in fine floral brocade motifs and a striking contrast petni pallu. The bold pallu is finished with rich ghetti panels, lending a beautifully balanced harmony to the design.

nalli:10176046530859.description: The Anudhyana Kanjeevaram saree from our Indira collection honours cultural heritage through classic motifs. Its body features traditional Rudraksh symbols, while the border carries graceful Annapakshi patterns divided by slender Rudraksh Pet stripes. The grand pallu unites the design with alternating bands of Annapakshi and Rudraksh.

nalli:10176046563627.description: The 'Aparajita' Kanjeevaram silk saree from our Indira collection highlights traditional weaving through refined detailing. Its plain silk body contrasts gracefully with a korvai border featuring small thazhampoo reku temple motifs and delicate floral zari. The contrasting ghetti pallu carries these floral elements and frames into a honeycomb design in gold-zari.
tags: Koadu Kattam and Half & Half - Half Fine/Without Zari
